headline: GitLab and Cisco ASA/FTD flaws join CISA KEV; Cisco SD-WAN KeyDrift attacks continue; UNM Health ransomware and 4.9M Florida breach

bullets.text: New: CISA added GitLab CE/EE CVE-2026-97229 and Cisco ASA/FTD CVE-2026-76418 to its KEV list, both with a 2026-11-01 federal due date. An attacker already tried CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) against Alpine Linux's GitLab.

Attackers are exploiting Cisco SD-WAN flaw CVE-2026-20127 to deploy custom KeyDrift malware, tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' network. Cisco's ASA/FTD VPN zero-day CVE-2026-76418 is being used to crash SSL VPN devices.

China-linked attackers used VMware ESX zero-day CVE-2026-41709, a low-severity logging flaw, to reduce audit trail visibility, while PHP2Shell and Fragnesia were chained to root firewalls. PHP2Shell is covered by seven outlets.

Exploitation attempts have begun against Oracle E-Business Suite RCE flaw CVE-2026-101767, days after Oracle patched it. Separately, attackers turned GitHub issues into a supply-chain campaign against 61 public repos in under an hour.
New: UNM Health is responding to a cyberattack claimed by a ransomware group (six outlets), and Florida's education department says a breach may affect 4.9 million people.

Other breaches: Belgium's tax agency pulled services offline after a cyberattack; 2.6 million records stolen from Sony's ISP So-net; hacktivists leaked records on 41,000 DHS staff; iRhythm toll put at 8.2 million.

actions: Patch self-managed GitLab CE/EE for CVE-2026-97229 before 2026-11-01 and check GitLab logs for exploitation attempts.
Apply Cisco's fix for ASA/FTD VPN CVE-2026-76418 before 2026-11-01 and review VPN logs and device crashes.
Patch Cisco SD-WAN for CVE-2026-20127 per Cisco's advisory and hunt for KeyDrift malware on SD-WAN components.
Finish PHP updates (KEV due date for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 has passed) and check PHP hosts for compromise.
Patch VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 (KEV due 2026-11-11) and confirm Oracle's fix for EBS CVE-2026-101767 is applied.
Apply your distro's kernel fix for CVE-2026-46300 before 2026-10-31; patch Adobe Commerce/Magento and Brotli by 2026-11-10.
